entries.name: Cover a Companion
entries.effect: Before an attack on an adjacent ally: +1 Bane if it can obstruct the attacker.
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Cover a Companion

*The guardian steps into the line of danger, making the attacker work around its raised guard.*

Before a visible enemy attacks a willing ally adjacent to this creature, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll if this creature can see the attacker. Against an NPC attack, grant that ally 1 Boon to its defense instead. This creature must also be adjacent to the attacker, or hold a shield the DA judges can obstruct the attack. No movement, target substitution or damage transfer. For a single player area attack, use the normal worst-target modifiers; do not roll again.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Brace the approach and use the spear to push foes out of formation. Keep the shield Reaction for a consequential blockable attack.

**Encounter and conversation:** The guard's orders require protecting civilians, creating leverage against a reckless commander.

**Habitat:** Settlement; frontier; contested road · **Communication:** Common and its community’s language

**Loot:** Ordinary carried gear and 8 coins; special rewards belong to the adventure.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-hobgoblin-shieldguard


**Category:** Mortal · **Role:** Displacer · **CV:** 22

### Creature-roll reference

| Ranked spear | Brawn | 1 Boon | 3 physical damage. | 4 physical damage. Push 1. | 6 physical damage. Push 3. |

Use the attributes above for defenses named by incoming attacks. Same targeting, limits and costs apply; no opposed second roll.

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 3/4/6

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.5

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.4 → 1.5: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=3.000, O=3.653. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [Cover a Companion](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/cover-a-companion.md), [driving blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/driving-blow.md), [shield hunker](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/shield-hunker.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.

# Shield Hunker

*The shield rises, scraping stone as its bearer crouches behind the rim.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-shield-hunker


**Action:** Reaction

Before a shield-blockable attack resolves, spend Reaction to gain 1 defense Boon until the start of this creature’s next turn. For an NPC, apply 1 Bane to player attacks it can block instead. The DA decides whether the shield can block an attack. This stacks with Defend through ordinary Boon/Bane rules. No repeated activation adds another copy.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
